Ifx library shall not require initialization phase. A Library function may be called at the very first step of ECU initialization, e.g. even by the OS or EcuM, thus the library shall be ready.
Ifx library shall not require a shutdown operation phase.
The Ifx library shall be implemented in a way that the code can be shared among callers in different memory partitions.
Usage of macros should be avoided. The function should be de- clared as function or inline function. Macro #define should not be used.
A library function can call other library functions because all library functions shall be re-entrant. A library function shall not call any BSW modules func- tions, e.g. the DET.
The library, written in C programming language, should conform to the MISRA C Standard. Please refer to SWS_BSW_00115 for more details.
Each AUTOSAR library Module implementation <library>*.c and <library>*.h shall map their code to memory sections using the AUTOSAR memory mapping mechanism.
Each AUTOSAR library Module implementation <library>*.c, that uses AUTOSAR integer data types and/or the standard return, shall include the header file Std_Types.h.
All AUTOSAR library Modules should use the AUTOSAR data types (integers, boolean) instead of native C data types, unless this library is clearly identified to be compliant only with a platform.
All AUTOSAR library Modules should avoid direct use of compiler and platform specific keyword, unless this library is clearly identified to be compliant only with a platform. eg. #pragma, typeof etc.

When a multiplexed I-PDU is received from the PDU Router the function IpduM_RxIndication uses the incoming I-PDU ID and the selector field to find out the correct I-PDU ID for the dynamic part's destination and then forwards the I-PDU via the PDU Router, see PduR_IpduMRxIndication in the [10, SWS PDU Router].

The behavior of the IpduM is unspecified until a correct call to IpduM_Init is made.
The function IpduM_RxIndication shall be callable in inter- rupt context, e.g. from receive interrupt.
The function IpduM_TxConfirmation shall be callable in in- terrupt context, e.g. from a transmit interrupt.
The function IpduM_TxConfirmation shall translate the confirmation received from the PDU Router into confirmations for the I-PDUs which where contained in the sent multiplexed I-PDU or Container PDU.
The function IpduM_TriggerTransmit shall be callable in interrupt context.

Within the function IpduM_TriggerTransmit , the IpduM shall copy the contents of its I-PDU transmit buffer to the PDU buffer given by PduIn- foPtr ->SduDataPtr and update PduInfoPtr ->SduLength with length of the copied data accordingly.
The IpduM shall take care about the data consistency during providing the data.
The IpduM shall be implemented so that no other modules depend on it and that it is be possible to build a system without the IpduM module if it is not needed.
The IpduM module shall not set the selector field.
